title: European Parental Leave Policies
text:
Code
library(tidyverse)
library(sf)
library(rnaturalearth)
library(gganimate)
library(magick)




Code
eplp <- readr::read_csv('https://raw.githubusercontent.com/rfordatascience/tidytuesday/main/data/2026/2026-06-02/eplp.csv')




Code
europe <- ne_countries(continent = "europe", returnclass = "sf")
yrs <- sort(unique(eplp$year))

p <- europe |>
    mutate(country2 = ifelse(iso_a2_eh == "GB", "UK", iso_a2_eh)) |>
    tidyr::expand_grid(year = yrs) |>
    st_as_sf() |>
    left_join(eplp, by = c("country2" = "country", "year")) |>
    ggplot() +
    geom_sf(aes(fill = jp_ld_m)) +
    coord_sf(xlim = c(-10, 45), ylim = c(27, 82)) +
    transition_states(year, transition_length = 0, state_length = 4) +
    labs(title = "Year: {closest_state}")

animate(p)

title: Foundation Shades
text:
Waffle Plot


Code
df_plot <- makeup |>
  group_by(brand) |>
  mutate(
    id = row_number(),
    x = (id - 1) %% 10,
    y = (id - 1) %/% 10,
    hex = sort(hex)
  ) |>
  ungroup()

ggplot(df_plot, aes(x = x, y = -y)) +
  geom_tile(
    aes(fill = hex),
    width = 0.95,
    height = 0.95
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~ brand) +
  scale_fill_identity() +
  coord_equal() +
  theme_void() +
  theme(
    strip.text = element_text(
      size = 14,
      face = "bold"
    ),
    panel.spacing = unit(2, "lines")
  )
